tier_1_adopted.name: Ahrefs MCP
tier_1_adopted.install_method: claude mcp add ahrefs --transport http https://api.ahrefs.com/mcp/mcp
tier_1_adopted.primary_use: competitive intelligence, market analysis, SEO tracking
tier_1_adopted.notes: Direct HTTP remote transport. Complements Anansi. Start with free trial.

tier_1_adopted.name: Playwright MCP
tier_1_adopted.what_it_does: Browser automation, JavaScript rendering, session management
tier_1_adopted.install_method: Node.js or Python wrapper; expose via MCP interface
tier_1_adopted.primary_use: portal scraping, booking reads, dynamic content
tier_1_adopted.notes: Already used in scripts/regent_booking_capture.py. Akamai limitation documented; mitigate with Bright Data/Scrapfly.
known_limitations: Regent ASPXAUTH headless auth blocked by Akamai
Requires anti-bot service integration for enterprise reliability
See MISSION-214 (Regent Portal On-Demand) for workaround details

tier_1_adopted.name: SegmentStream MCP
tier_1_adopted.what_it_does: Marketing analytics, conversion data, audience insights
tier_1_adopted.primary_use: conversion intelligence, pricing strategy, EOD brief
tier_1_adopted.notes: No-cost adoption now; activation deferred until D2M chooses CDP platform (Segment, Tealium, or similar).

tier_2_trial.name: HubSpot MCP
tier_2_trial.what_it_does: CRM object access (contacts, deals, tasks), sales automation
tier_2_trial.install_method: Via Claude connectors or MCP config
tier_2_trial.primary_use: client lifecycle automation, FPD alerts, commission tracking
trial_tasks: Map dossier YAML to HubSpot CRM schema
Test agent: dossier → HubSpot contact/deal creation
Evaluate vs. current dossier + mission board workflow
tier_2_trial.notes: Requires CRM adoption strategy decision before production deployment. Sandbox trial is zero-cost.

tier_2_trial.name: Sanity MCP
tier_2_trial.what_it_does: Content management, structured document access, workflows
tier_2_trial.install_method: npx sanity@latest mcp configure OR remote HTTP
tier_2_trial.primary_use: itinerary library, port guides, content templates, scaling
trial_tasks: Stand up Sanity project with sample port guides
Deploy Sanity MCP in Claude Code
Test agent: retrieve guide → format as itinerary section
Evaluate vs. current Drive + TESS architecture
tier_2_trial.notes: Strategic value for future scaling. No immediate use case; sandbox trial is low-cost.

strategic_gaps.description: No first-party MCP exists for Regent, TESS, Centrav, Expedia TAAP, or cruise line inventory APIs
strategic_gaps.impact: Manual booking reads; no automated commission reconciliation; slow itinerary generation
strategic_gaps.recommendation: Commission custom MCP server for TESS (read voyage bookings) + Regent portal (read availability) + Centrav B2B (read fares)
strategic_gaps.effort_estimate: 2–3 weeks design, 4–6 weeks build per MCP
strategic_gaps.roi: 3x faster itinerary generation, 10x faster pricing, automated commission reconciliation
strategic_gaps.next_step: Design session (ELON + Sterling + Dembe) in Week 3; Prompt Charter; decision on build vs. vendor

review_items: Ahrefs: ROI validation, quota costs, team adoption
Playwright: Portal automation success rate, Akamai workaround effectiveness
Custom Travel MCP: Build status, go-live readiness
